description: The image displays three pie charts labeled "easy," "medium," and "hard," each representing the distribution of performance across four categories—N+K+, N−K+, N−K−, and N+K−—for a task referred to as "Zero-Shot." A legend on the right side of the image identifies the four categories with corresponding colors: N+K+ (dark teal), N−K+ (light brown), N−K− (tan), and N+K− (reddish-brown). Each pie chart has percentage values labeled within its respective slices, and the overall layout suggests a comparison of performance across difficulty levels.
